title: Baguio ‘Horror Festival’ rebranded as ‘Fantasy Festival’ after dialogue
summary: Organizers of the proposed Baguio Horror Festival are dropping the horror theme. They will instead hold a “Fantasy Festival” following a dialogue with city officials, residents and other stakeholders.
